claim: Freeze and benchmark the observational experiment that will decide which per-galaxy formulas enter the G1 atlas. This configuration calibrates mechanics and comparators; it does not discover or validate a gravity law.

radial_holdout.rule: For a galaxy with n radius-ordered rows, k=min(5,n) folds are the contiguous half-open blocks [floor(i*n/k), floor((i+1)*n/k)) for i=0..k-1. Every row is held out exactly once; no fold interleaves radii.

baselines.source: McGaugh, Lelli and Schombert, Physical Review Letters 117, 201101 (2016)

baselines.fit_scope: training radii inside each radial fold only
baselines.source: Navarro, Frenk and White, Astrophysical Journal 490, 493 (1997)

score.uncertainty: published e_Vobs random uncertainty in km/s
score.primary: sum of squared standardized held-out velocity residuals
secondary: coverage within one, two and three published sigmas
score.limitation: SPARC e_Vobs excludes systematic inclination uncertainty; G0 scores are conditional on the published random-error column and must not be described as a complete likelihood.

g1_formula_admission.empirical_rar_rule: candidate held-out chi-square must be no greater than empirical_rar held-out chi-square
g1_formula_admission.halo_ceiling_rule: candidate held-out chi-square may exceed nfw_halo_ceiling by at most 2 times the galaxy's held-out row count
g1_formula_admission.coverage_rule: candidate two-sigma coverage must be at least the smaller of 0.90 and the nfw_halo_ceiling two-sigma coverage
g1_formula_admission.atlas_gate: all 139 admitted exploration galaxies must have at least one admitted local formula

g1_description_length.formula_code: 8 times the UTF-8 byte count of the canonical typed-IR JSON with sorted keys and compact separators
g1_description_length.local_constant_code: 64 bits per fitted galaxy-local real constant
g1_description_length.grammar_address_code: ceiling(log2(number of canonical candidates in the declared grammar version)) bits
g1_description_length.selection_rule: description length is a Pareto objective beside held-out score, calibration, robustness, and compute; it may not be used to discard a formula that uniquely clears a predictive stratum

g1_search_budget_and_stopping.continue_condition: continue the current grammar while the last checkpoint creates any new admitted canonical equivalence class or improves a currently uncovered galaxy; otherwise retain failures and propose a new grammar version
g1_search_budget_and_stopping.anti_pruning_rule: a branch may not be stopped solely because an LLM labels it known, uncertain, or unlikely; only typed invalidity, a frozen empirical failure, proven equivalence, or exhaustion of its declared finite cell may close it
g1_search_budget_and_stopping.completion_rule: G1 passes only at 139/139 covered galaxies; reaching a compute ceiling without coverage is a visible G1 failure, not permission to advance

forbidden: V_obs or any function of V_obs

throughput_benchmark.grammar: nu(y)=[P_5(y^-1/2)/Q_5(y^-1/2)]^beta with ten coefficients in {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3} and beta in {1/3,1/2,1,2}
